statement: Sealed Raft snapshot checkpoint generations transfer between nodes over a dedicated per-peer bulk WebSocket channel under the existing identity/admission handshake (IDENTIFY with a channel marker forked before router record mutation with listener detachment; the primary connection is never rekeyed, evicted, or reconnect-fought; pre-claim frame discipline enforced), carrying versioned receiver-driven protocol traffic — JSON text control frames (offer/accept/chunk-request/complete/typed abort) and length-prefixed binary chunk frames binding transferId, chunkIndex, byte length, and sha256 chunk digest — with explicit protocol/geometry negotiation, per-socket maxPayload, sender-side token-bucket byte-rate pacing, single in-flight chunk per peer, and AbortSignal cancellation; the receiver appends verified chunks to transfer staging with per-chunk fsync, durably records the verified boundary in a canonical progress marker, resumes after restart ONLY from the re-digested verified boundary (mismatch restarts from zero, typed), aborts typed on version, geometry, identity, or stale-epoch change at accept and completion, verifies the streamed whole-payload digest and byte length against the descriptor at completion, and publishes the generation at the bare-decimal checkpointsRoot layout with S1 publication-token semantics; bulk load is visible to the pressure governor via a snapshot-transfer resource prefix, a BULK capacity partition, and bulk-channel stats fed into the router stats summary (sensor advisory, sender bucket enforcing); the transport owner card names the bulk lane contract; proven by the deterministic guard scenario raft-snapshot-bulk-transfer: transport lane-isolation guard (critical enqueue+dispatch unaffected and quarantine untouched under bulk saturation), DT6 cost-table convergence guard with live election timers (bounded chunk charges on the serving node keep heartbeat/election budgets met; the unbounded negative control blows them), protocol resume/tamper/truncation/digest/epoch guards, plus the unweakened S1/S2 and gated-compaction regression files, passing 3 consecutive runs.
